status: linear representation diagnostic; projection methods using target coefficients are oracles

definitions.low_band_span: target projected with oracle coefficients onto the per-environment low-band spatial span
definitions.full_band_oracle: target projected onto a basis fitted with all query fields; representation lower bound only
definitions.latent_polynomial: deployable per-environment polynomial extrapolation of low-band latent coefficients
definitions.masked_frequency_polynomial: odd visible frequencies withheld and reconstructed from even frequency tokens
definitions.patch_span: each spatial patch has an independent low-band basis; target coefficients remain oracle
